skill.name: email-drafter
skill.description: Drafts professional business emails, replies, meeting requests, follow-ups, and sensitive workplace messages with structured guidance.
skill.summary: Create clear, professional business emails for common workplace situations.
skill.author: shubhamsaboo

content.value_statement: Writing clear workplace email can take time and create tone concerns. This skill helps draft structured messages for common business situations.
actual_capabilities: Drafts professional emails using subject, greeting, opening, body, call to action, and closing.
Creates meeting request emails with topic, objective, duration, and date options.
Writes follow-up emails that reference prior conversations and include a specific ask.
Adjusts tone for formal, professional, friendly, or direct workplace communication.
Supports difficult or sensitive business messages with clear structure.
limitations: It does not send emails or connect to an email account.
It needs accurate recipient, context, timeline, and desired outcome details.
It does not verify calendar availability, commitments, or factual claims.
It focuses on business communication, not legal notices or regulated disclosures.

use_cases.title: Schedule Project Discussions
use_cases.description: Create concise meeting requests that explain the topic, goal, duration, and proposed times.

use_cases.title: Follow Up After Outreach
use_cases.description: Draft polite follow-ups that restate context and ask for a clear response by a deadline.

use_cases.title: Handle Sensitive Workplace Messages
use_cases.description: Turn difficult updates into professional emails with an appropriate tone and direct next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Meeting Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a professional email asking [recipient] for a [duration] meeting about [topic]. Include [date options] and a clear reason.

prompt_templates.title: Polite Follow-Up
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a follow-up email to [recipient] about [original topic]. Mention [previous contact date], restate the ask, and request a reply by [deadline].

prompt_templates.title: Tone Revision
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this draft for a [formal, professional, friendly, or direct] tone. Keep the message clear and preserve the main request: [draft].

prompt_templates.title: Sensitive Business Message
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a sensitive email to [recipient] about [situation]. Include context, impact, proposed next steps, and a respectful closing.

output_examples.input: Ask a vendor for a 30-minute meeting next week to review delayed onboarding tasks.
output_examples.output:
Subject: Meeting Request: Onboarding Task Review

Hi [Name],

I would like to review the delayed onboarding tasks and align on next steps.

Could we meet for 30 minutes next week? I am available Tuesday morning or Thursday afternoon.

Topics to cover:
- Current blockers
- Updated owners and dates
- Support needed from each team

Please let me know which time works best.

Best regards,
[Name]

output_examples.input: Follow up with a colleague who has not sent feedback from last Friday.
output_examples.output:
Subject: Following Up: Feedback on Last Friday's Draft

Hi [Name],

I wanted to follow up on the draft I sent last Friday.

Your feedback will help me finalize the next version before the team review.

Could you send your comments by Wednesday afternoon?

Thanks,
[Name]

best_practices: Provide the recipient, relationship, desired outcome, deadline, and preferred tone.
Ask for a clear subject line and one specific call to action.
Review names, dates, commitments, and sensitive details before sending.
anti_patterns: Do not use it to invent facts, approvals, or commitments.
Do not send sensitive messages without human review.
Do not request manipulative, deceptive, or coercive email language.

faq.question: Can this skill send email for me?
faq.answer: No. It drafts email text that you can review and send from your own email client.

faq.question: What types of emails does it support?
faq.answer: It supports meeting requests, follow-ups, professional replies, difficult messages, and sensitive workplace communication.

faq.question: Can I choose the tone?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes formal, professional, friendly, and direct tone guidance.

faq.question: Does it need context?
faq.answer: Yes. Better results require recipient details, purpose, deadlines, and the action you want from the reader.

faq.question: Is it suitable for legal or regulated email?
faq.answer: It can improve clarity, but legal, compliance, or regulated messages need expert review.

faq.question: Can it rewrite an existing draft?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the draft and desired tone, then ask for a clearer professional version.
